items.headline: Novartis pelacarsen drug fails Phase 3 trial; pharma stocks extend losses
items.detail: Novartis and Ionis' lipoprotein(a)-lowering drug pelacarsen failed to reduce cardiovascular event risk in its Phase 3 trial announced Sept 4, triggering a 9% plunge in Novartis shares—the worst performer on STOXX600 today. The setback raises questions about a broader class of Lp(a)-lowering therapies, wiping an estimated $6B in peak annual sales from Novartis' pipeline expectations.

items.headline: European equities sold off sharply; energy inflation surge weighs on sentiment
items.detail: FTSE 100 fell 1.38%, DAX dropped 1.6%, CAC40 declined ~2% as all major European indices moved lower together. Energy inflation surged to 14.3% in August—highest since January 2023—with Iran tensions and Strait of Hormuz disruptions pushing crude and natural gas higher. Rising energy costs amplified inflation concerns ahead of tomorrow's ECB decision.

items.headline: ECB rate hike fully priced in; markets lock 98.9% probability for tomorrow's decision
items.detail: Market pricing placed the probability of a 25bp ECB rate hike tomorrow at 98.9%, with the decision announcement scheduled for 14:15 CET in Berlin and press conference at 14:45 CET. The hike to 2.5% reflects eurozone inflation running at 3.3% in August versus ECB's 2% target, with core inflation at 2.4%, providing minimal dovish cover.
